description: A sheet of blue-green scales, cold and slick. Nothing in this valley wears a coat quite like it.
lore: Hold a piece in a closed fist as long as you can stand it and it will still be cold when you let go, and so will your hand, for an hour after. [[characters/54bead23|Osric]] has a strip stitched into the back of his left glove — the hand that holds the work, not the hammer — and it has bought him a few more seconds at the anvil every day for two years. That is not why he bought it. He bought it because a man three years dead can set this stuff on a bench, come back in the morning, and find it behaving exactly as it did the morning before, which is more than the grass outside the forge will do for him. The gold along one edge is where the blue stopped and something else began. The strip will not say what.
gm_notes: The creature stays unidentified on purpose — this record is about a newly woken man homesick for materials that behave. The gold edge is a hook for whoever draws the animal later.
